csv_project_name: Design for Mohican State Park Maintenance Bldg Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR), through the Divisions of Parks and Watercraft, is responsible for the management of various specialized facilities located at properties across the State. This Request for Qualifications (RFQ) is being issued to procure Professional Design (A/E) services for improvements to the existing maintenance building located within Mohican State Park in Loudonville, Ohio, Ashland County. The purpose of this project is to modernize, repair, and enhance the facility to better support park operations and improve functionality for staff. The selected Architectural firm will evaluate the existing building conditions and develop design solutions that address operational needs, code compliance, safety, and long term maintenance.
